results.label: a second zone method exists exactly when the tree being measured ships one — on the parent there is no vocabulary and no walk to ask for
an analysis states which geometry it ran on exactly when the tree can run two, and on the parent the payload has no zone-method key at all (the question cannot even be asked there)
and asking for the range geometry either widens the boxes or is simply an unrecognised parameter — the parent ignores it and returns the identical zones
the wider box is measurable in the candles, not just in a label: the range method catches a return price made into the consolidation without touching the pivot candle

the choice can be stored exactly when the settings route knows the key — and where it does not, the SAME body is accepted and silently ignored, which is the fault: a request the app does not implement reads back as a success
and an unrecognised method is rejected with its own code exactly when the route validates it; the parent stores nothing because it has never heard of the key
the stored preference is the trader’s own row, so a choice made once is consulted by the next request rather than living in the request that made it
the Settings pane offers the choice, and the analysis page names the geometry it read, exactly when the tree ships both
and on the parent neither exists: there is no control to pick a geometry with and no line on the analysis page to say which one it used
the milestone adds NO table, index, trigger or column of its own on any tree — the choice lives in the settings JSON the app already stores
and reading either geometry writes no row of its own: the trader’s stored settings are byte-identical across both reads

scope: M30 control (delivered): the one geometry nothing could name: actual runtime/auth/SQL/HTTP with a frozen UTC clock, a synthetic calendar fed through the app's own parser and a patched market module for the thrown-read path; M111 calendar-read states (blocked/clear/unknown), no provider/broker/pixel/human proof and no claim about what a release does to price
